jurisdictionDistinctions.description: Sovereign administrative entities under the First Schedule of the Constitution of India.
Territorial constituencies for election to the House of the People under Article 81.
Territorial constituencies for election to Legislative Assemblies across 31 States/UTs under Article 170.
Upper chambers for AP, Bihar, Karnataka, Maharashtra, Telangana, and UP under Article 171 (distinct from Assemblies).
Council of States indirect seats allocated under the Fourth Schedule of the Constitution.
Sub-district administrative jurisdictions established by State statutory orders (G.O.Ms. 214-245 in TS).
